name: hydra-tangler
description: Language client for the Hydra Tangler language server.

hydra.serverCommand.description: Command and arguments that start the language server. Empty uses uv run --project <hydra package> hydra serve, with the workspace folder as the working directory.

hydra.write.description: When true, saving a Markdown file tangles outputs into the build directory.

hydra.pyrightCommand.description: Command and arguments for the basedpyright checker. Empty uses uv run --project <workspace> basedpyright --outputjson.

hydra.pyrightServerCommand.description: Command and arguments for the basedpyright language server. Empty uses uv run --project <workspace> basedpyright-langserver --stdio.

hydra.ruffCommand.description: Command and arguments for the ruff checker. Empty uses uv run --project <workspace> ruff check --output-format json.

hydra.trace.server.description: Traces communication between the extension and the Hydra language server.
